title: Reverberation
excerpt: Stereo reverb module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) made of one [rev3~] object with its basic...
content:
Stereo reverb module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) made of one [rev3~] object with its basic controls (but with an input send-like volume control) and a high-pass filter behind it, all in one page with minimalist graphics.

knob1 : (send) input volume (%)
knob2 : liveness / feedback (ice-blue led when reaching max = infinite feedback / freeze)
knob3 : HP filter (0-1000Hz)
knob4 : damping HF (500-7000Hz)

aux : shows revision number, knobs mapping and global CPU usage

#1 copy reverberation_1-4.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install reverberation..."

v1.4 now installed into /media/orac/usermodules/fx , press aux for infos

v1.3 : knob3 is now a post-reverb high-pass filter, minor graphic changes
